how_this_was_run: Each call was made live by the vibe coder (Claude Code) through the campus-customs MCP server it connected to from .mcp.json on 2026-10-10 (tools mcp__campus-customs__check_stock, get_ticket, check_margin). 'prompt' is the request that calls for that tool. 'matches_database' compares the tool output with values read independently from data/campus_customs_new.db with plain SQL (sqlite3).

results.prompt: Ticket 101: Tauhid Zaman wants a Bulldog tee, size S. Check how many CC-TEE-WHITE size S we have on hand and whether we are short for 1 unit.
Ticket 102: Elm City Properties says rent is due in 2 days. Read ticket 102, find its lease, and tell me the rent amount and how many days until it is due today.

ticket.subject: Rent due
ticket.notes: Email: shop rent due in 2 days.

results.prompt: Ticket 103: Yale AI Club wants a bulk discount on 20 CC-HOOD-NAVY hoodies. Check the margin if we sell at $50 per hoodie.
